## Kindle Custom Screensaver v0.6.1

This release fixes PIN unlock on firmware 5.20.1.0.2 and possibly other 5.20+ firmware.

### Changes

* Fixes the PIN dialog staying hidden behind the screensaver, which left the Kindle stuck on the screensaver until a reboot when a device PIN was set (#10)

### Installation and updates

Available through KPM or the `custom-screensaver-0.6.1-kindlehf.zip` release package.

See the README for full installation and update instructions.
